description: He wears an ivory ankle-length tunic with subtle woven floral texture, gold and dark patterned trim at the neckline, sleeve cuffs and lower hem. A deep burgundy outer robe with embroidered borders hangs open over it, and matching fabric drapes diagonally across the torso and over one shoulder, fastened by a round jeweled brooch. A dark decorated waist belt has a round gold clasp and a long hanging panel with medallions and a tassel. Dark brown leather boots emerge below the tunic.
